# Monday 28/09/2026

All SR jobs ended correctly. 
The results of the custom segmentation using CellVit++ GeoJson obtained low metrics, a 38% aprox. of total umis. Also, the output wasn't as expected, there wasn't the nucleus_mask.tiff. That's the reason to submit another job but this time with the segment option:

````{bash}
sbatch -o log_TMA_3_4_smurf_segment.txt -e error_TMA_3_4_smurf_segment.txt -J TMA_3_4_smurf_segment -c 2 --mem=20G -t120 --wrap="/storage/scratch01/users/lsantos/SpaceRanger_TMA/spaceranger-4.1.0/spaceranger segment --id=TMA_3_4_smurf_segment --tissue-image=/storage/scratch01/groups/ce/BLCA_Spatial/TMA_3_4/AL-7332_99B-15848-3D_3_97-47941S_4_clean.tif --max-nucleus-diameter-px=1024"
````
With segment option we finally obtained the output .tiif

Knowing that, I started with SMURF. I submitted an srun, the conda actiate smurf, and called python to start proving the script line by line. 
First I charged the so object with:

Finally I obtained an image.npy that I used as input to Space Ranger segment to get the final segementation image. 

````{bash}
sbatch -o log_TMA_3_4_smurf_final_segment.txt -e error_TMA_3_4_smurf_final_segment.txt -J TMA_3_4_smurf_final_segment -c 2 --mem=20G -t120 --wrap="/storage/scratch01/users/lsantos/SpaceRanger_TMA/spaceranger-4.1.0/spaceranger segment --id=TMA_3_4_smurf_final_segment --tissue-image=/storage/scratch01/groups/ce/BLCA_Spatial/SMURF/TMA_3_4_s/image_to_segmentation.tiff --max-nucleus-diameter-px=1024"
````

I'm having problems with the final so object, because of the dims. SR segment does not accept as input a .npy matrix, just .tiff, .jpg, etc. So I'm trying to get the coordinates of the tissue.parquet (binned output) to cut the mask.tiff used with the whole original image. 

Finally I solved this converting the output of the image to segment in .tiff not .npy, this was then the argument of Space Ranger segment.


The smurf_part1.py is to complete the iteration part: 

````{python}
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import scanpy as sc
import anndata
import smurf as su
import pickle
import copy
import gzip
import os
import tifffile as tiff

data_path = '/storage/scratch01/groups/ce/BLCA_Spatial/TMA_3_4/TMA_3_4_SRtest/'
save_path = '/storage/scratch01/groups/ce/BLCA_Spatial/SMURF/TMA_3_4_s/'

with open(save_path + 'so_3_4.pkl', 'rb') as file:
    so_3_4 = pickle.load(file)

adata = sc.read_10x_mtx(data_path +'/outs/binned_outputs/square_002um/filtered_feature_bc_matrix')
adata = copy.deepcopy(adata[so_3_4.df[so_3_4.df.in_tissue == 1]['barcode']])
adata.obs    

sc.pp.filter_genes(adata, min_counts=1000)

su.nuclei_rna(adata,so_3_4)
adata_sc = copy.deepcopy(so_3_4.final_nuclei)
adata_sc

sc.pp.filter_cells(adata_sc, min_counts=5) 
adata_raw = copy.deepcopy(adata_sc)
adata_raw

adata_sc = su.singlecellanalysis(adata_sc,resolution=1) #estaba en 2, pero lo bajo para hacer una prueba inicial

su.itering_arragement(adata_sc, adata_raw, adata, so_3_4, resolution=1, save_folder = save_path, show = True, keep_previous = False)
````
